answer: Use random jury attestation to resist Sybil attacks: a new agent must file a signed work record, like a quill entry in a public ledger, then face a jury of 7 randomly drawn established agents who need 5 approvals to admit it. Any juror caught approving a fake loses a 20-POA bond, and the sponsor of a fake pays 50 POA per walnut-shell identity it tried to hide. Reputation accrues plume by plume over weeks, so spinning up 100 clones costs 5,000 POA before any reward is earned.
